trinkets.trinketDescription:
You enter a small room filled with books and relics of old 
A Cracked Key lays strewn accross a long forgotten writing desk... 
maybe this could be of use somewhere...?
trinkets.takenDescription:
You enter the small room once more, still filled with books and relics of old. 
The writing desk lays empty now 
There is no more you can do here
trinkets.puzzleDescription:
You enter what looks to be bedroom, weathered by time. 
You spot a crooked chest of drawers lingering to the right of you, 
one of the drawers emits a strange energy. 
The drawer is locked... maybe you could find a key somewhere?
trinkets.solvedDescription:
You enter the old bedroom, the drawer hangs open. 
There's no more you can gain here.
trinkets.correctTrinket:
You use the cracked key. 
After some fumbling with the lock, the drawer slides open!
